title: File-Based Configuration Manager (Singleton)
instructions: Implement `FileBasedConfigurationManagerImpl` in `config/config_manager_impl.py` as a thread-safe, lazily created singleton (double-checked locking) with a `reset_instance()` test hook. Add the get/set/remove/clear configuration operations on top of the provided base class in `config/config_manager.py`, which you must not edit.

evidence.label: get_instance() returns the same shared object every time
Concurrent get_instance() calls yield exactly one instance
reset_instance() makes the next get_instance() a brand-new, empty object
Gets a missing key as None and sets or overwrites values
Stores str(value) and converts typed reads (None when absent)
A value that cannot be converted raises ValueError
remove ignores absent keys and clear empties the settings
Loaded file settings are visible through the shared instance
